top_signals.title: Japan’s Export Growth Stays Solid as Shipments of Chips Jump
top_signals.summary: Japan’s export growth slowed a tad in August while remaining at an elevated pace, with shipments of semiconductors and chips manufacturing equipment surging.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
